timeline.summary: TVS Holdings held its NCLT-convened equity shareholders meeting on April 24, 2026, approving the scheme of arrangement with 99.9977% majority.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹15,587.53 Cr (+32.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹424.11 Cr (+49.9% YoY).
H1FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹37,258.71 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹1,245.04 Cr.
TVS Motor Company's board approved a composite scheme of arrangement on October 28, 2026, to demerge its consumer finance business into Harita ARC Limited via a 1:1 share swap.
